summary: This is a distinct safety_rule (micro-level assessment skill) that evaluates preconditions for applying maximum tf normalization. It complements the peer_candidates by providing a go/no-go gate before the normalization technique is deployed. The peer candidates (Maximum TF Normalization, TF-IDF variants) are executable micro_skills for term weighting; this candidate is a stability assessment rule that prevents unsafe application of those techniques. No redundancy detected.
